description: Read tfl-ts bundled agent docs offline (same catalogue as `tfl docs`). No TfL API call, no credentials. Prefer list → find → read; use grep to locate symbols across docs. Large files are paginated by line.

id.description: Doc id or path for operation=read (e.g. "CLAUDE.md", "docs/mcp.md").

limit.description: For read: max lines (default 80). For grep: max matches (default 50).

offset.description: For read: 0-based line offset. For grep: 0-based match offset.

operation.description: list catalogue | read one doc | find by id/title/audience/body | grep content

pattern.description: For operation=grep: literal substring (not regex), same as CLI.

query.description: For operation=find: keyword against id, title, audience, or body.

name: docs
